steps.text: As a member you do not see the community's dossiers: you only see the information about you that was sent to the regulator, and in which document.
steps.title: What has been filed about me

steps.text: Every block shows the values exactly as they were frozen at filing time. A later correction in the CRM does not rewrite what was already submitted — the date shown is what counts.
